spec: next_id() -> int and reset_ids() -> None. next_id() returns 1 on its first call, then 2, then 3, and so on (one counter shared by all callers). reset_ids() resets the counter so that the next call to next_id() returns 1 again. Define both functions in solution.py.
reference_solution:
_counter = 0

def next_id():
    global _counter
    _counter += 1
    return _counter

def reset_ids():
    global _counter
    _counter = 0
